strings.Meu neto,\n\nSe você está lendo esta car:
My dear grandchild,

If you are reading this letter, you have arrived in our village. I still remember you as a little one, running across the sand while I opened the kiosk. You used to say the sea smelled like adventure. I would answer that it also smelled like home.

Our business began with a counter, a few coconuts and the wish to welcome whoever came by. Not every day was easy. When the wind turned, it was the people of the village who helped us carry on. Every chair holds a conversation; every customer left a little piece of their story with us.

Today my hands need to rest a little more, but the family dream still has a long way to go. I want to hand the kiosk over to you. Open the doors, meet our neighbors and make this place yours too.

If you can, help the business grow. But remember that the most valuable thing we built never fit in a cash register: it was the warmth with which we welcomed every person.

Take your time. Even from afar, I will be cheering for you with every new tide.

With all my love,
Grandma Dilce
